commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Alberto Paleari has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
90+4' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
90+2' The Pisa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
